get.description: The API process is running. Says nothing about the database or the embedding model.

Checks the database, migrations, the vector extension, file storage and the embedding model files.
Never calls the LLM provider.

503.description: A required dependency is not ready

post.description: Upload a PDF and queue it for ingestion (202). The same file again returns the existing document (200).

200.description: This file is already in the corpus; nothing was queued.

delete.description: Removes the document, its file, its indexes, and any answer history that quoted it. Cannot be undone.

get.description: Stored text of one physical page from the active index version, with extraction warnings.

post.description: Queue a rebuild of the document's index. The current index stays searchable until the new one is ready.
Rank passages from active, fully indexed documents. Exact search: every chunk is compared.

file.title: File
file.description: A PDF. Checked by content, not by file name.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx response from /api/v1 has this shape.

MetadataPatch.title: MetadataPatch
MetadataPatch.description: Corrections to bibliographic metadata. Send only the fields to change; null clears an optional field.

score_note.title: Score Note
score_note.default: Cosine distance (lower is closer) and similarity (1 - distance) only order the results. They are not probabilities that a passage is relevant or correct.
